metadata.name: investscape-global-settings
metadata.description: Shared four-language, theme and country/currency display preferences with a device-local host store.

properties.name: startingModule
properties.description: Preferred internal panel opened on entry to the main app page; defaults to Library.

events.name: preferenceChange
events.description: A supported field changed; host validates and persists the shared preferences then applies the native theme.

specifications: Host owns persistence; component emits only validated user changes.
No Auth, subscription, database, FX service or calculation calls.
Home country and portfolio currency never modify project amounts or property jurisdiction.
No widget customization or unimplemented shell choices shown.
Document language and title follow the shared locale in runtime; native page language key remains en.
Labels are draft translations pending native-language approval.
